시편 103:1.content: A Psalm of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

시편 103:2.content: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

시편 103:3.content: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

시편 103:4.content: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

시편 103:5.content: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

시편 103:6.content: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

시편 103:7.content: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

시편 103:8.content: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

시편 103:9.content: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

시편 103:10.content: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

시편 103:11.content: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

시편 103:12.content: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

시편 103:13.content: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.

시편 103:14.content: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

시편 103:15.content: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

시편 103:16.content: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

시편 103:17.content: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

시편 103:18.content: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

시편 103:19.content: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

시편 103:20.content: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

시편 103:21.content: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

시편 103:22.content: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.
